query: UPDATE workspaces w SET lease_conversation_id=$1, lease_expires_at=CASE WHEN w.lease_conversation_id=$1 AND w.lease_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+make_interval(secs=>$2) THEN w.lease_expires_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+make_interval(secs=>$2) END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM conversations c WHERE c.id=$1 AND w.id=c.workspace_id
